note: Buddy's bundled marketplace seed — ships with the package so /plugin browse works offline with zero setup. Community catalogs can replace it live via settings plugins.marketplaceUrl (one fetch, 5s cap, falls back to this seed honestly). Entries with "bundled": true install straight from this package's packs/ dir; everything else installs from its repo with /plugin add <owner>/<repo>.
